title: LINZ Data Service WMTS connection configured in QGIS
sourceName: Toitū Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand

altText: QGIS WMTS client or connection panel in a LINZ Data Service tutorial.
caption: A LINZ-published QGIS interface used to connect to its Web Map Tile Service (WMTS), an example of spatial information shared as a standardised network service.
dateDisplay: Date of original screenshot not independently established; LINZ guide current by 2026
context: Original software screenshot from LINZ's instructions for consuming nationally available tile services in GIS. The image illustrates standards and interoperable infrastructure, not a historical screen from 1990s SDI planning.
derivativesNote: Local original stored unchanged; WebP display width up to 1600 pixels and thumbnail width up to 720 pixels, resized without cropping.
